description: Liste des gares is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SNCF Réseau. Liste des gares du Réseau Ferré. Ce jeu de donnée liste les gares du réseau, en précisant leur type (gare voyageur ou gare de fret). Ce jeu publie les données en l’état des bases à la date de publication. Les éléments d’infrastructure sont localisés par projection sur la ligne correspondante. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports, Service. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Gares, Infrastructure, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 70 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
